plan.title: Maintain the Shards constants/derivation lane through managed-runtime completion
plan.body:
Goal: Maintain the Shards constants/derivation lane through managed-runtime completion, following canonical R01–R16 and the coordinator's approved queue: finish Poller/inotify primary-source checkpoints, continue TLS Handshake length/admission, QUIC datagram/credit bounds, and the four named unmeasured device rings. Send small signed checkpoints and immediately continue the next approved independent item; do not end the lane or mark this goal met when one report is ready. Research only assigned literals/alternatives until ROOT supplies measured/reproduced implementation authorization; all audits/profiling/heavy real E2E remain ROOT-owned. Done only when the coordinator confirms the lane's managed-runtime obligations accepted on main with actual evidence and releases the lane; otherwise propose the next precise test/derivation within these named seams while ROOT validates. Preserve current policy/readbacks, headroom, artifacts and paused Windows ARM; no fake keepalive, production guesses, child agents or self-main merges.

This plan is for the sustained implementer lane, not authorization to execute coordinator campaigns. Current signed research checkpoints: df37d254f366e8a7c9d75c876d816927860ee620 and c0db0f6ccd6780d9c703e1ae936674f1795e288f; the same owned note has a capacity-contract continuation in progress. Canonical current main24f/rules SHA256 d634fcb944959ce1e40a9277d12b0905fcfcebf82d9da9832e826f790a349242. Current repo ownership remains docs/research/managed-poller-capacity.md and textual docs/research/measurements/managed-poller-research/** until coordinator expands it. TLS/QUIC exact paths and the four ring identities are pending coordinator confirmation; the plan makes that scope resolution an explicit gate. Planning research cites protocol bounds but selects no numeric runtime policy, API or architecture. All runtime fault/fairness/cost/matrix claims remain unrun here.

Operational continuity: proceed through independent approved research while root validates; no child agents or fake keepalive/idle-wait loop. All profiling/audits/benchmarks/heavy/adversarial execution and main merges remain root-owned. No paused VM/root-goal resumption, protected cache/source mutation or host/admin/security/crypto changes are authorized. This planning phase becomes ready when sourced steps/acceptance/tests are recorded; the parent maintenance goal remains active until explicit coordinator release after actual main acceptance.

items.title: Research TLS Handshake length, fragmentation and admission at its confirmed seam
items.description: Use RFC8446 plus pinned established TLS implementations and the exact named Shards parser/callers. Separate the uint24 Handshake field from record framing, aggregate reassembly, concurrent sessions and admitted memory. Document checked arithmetic, fragmentation/coalescing, cold state, refusal before retention, cleanup/cancellation and typed uncertainty. Preserve all trust/verification/crypto behavior; propose no source fix from suspicion.

acceptance.text: Every investigated length/capacity literal is classified as a wire invariant, actual admitted resource bound, learned service decision or unexplained value, with exact sources and unresolved data needs.

Alternatives and a bounded coordinator reproduction/cost/mutation plan cover the actual caller; no record default, protocol maximum or one observed certificate/message size becomes a runtime allocation budget.

criteria.text: Plan includes fragmented headers/bodies, coalesced messages, valid encoded limits versus admitted limits, partial state, allocation/length overflow refusal and cancellation/cleanup without relaxing protocol verification.
RFC sections/revisions/errata context and established implementation pins are recorded; no live outcome or exact supported-library equivalence is inferred from documents.

items.title: Research QUIC packet/datagram bounds and credit ownership at its confirmed seam
items.description: Read RFC9000 and, only if the confirmed semantic feature uses unreliable DATAGRAM frames, RFC9221, plus pinned established implementations and the named Shards callers. Separate UDP/path/peer maximums, packet/frame overhead, stream/connection flow credits, congestion control and parent-owned memory/queue admission. Trace actual credit reservation/release/cancel ownership without a duplicate state cache or generic manager.

acceptance.text: The word datagram is resolved to the actual packet/frame/API semantics; peer/path/transport and owner resource constraints remain distinct, including cold negotiation, loss, zero length, overflow and failure.
Each proposed buffer or credit bound has a sourced derivation/method and a coordinator live proof plan; no1200/65535/library window or benchmark result is copied as unexplained policy.

testing.scenario: Coordinator-owed packet/frame boundary and negotiation cases

criteria.text: Plan covers peer limit changes, framing overhead and PMTU, valid/oversized/empty units, cold or absent negotiation, backpressure, cancellation/credit return and independent neighbor/control progress.

Any RFC9221 claim explicitly preserves its lack of stream/connection flow control while retaining congestion control and actual application storage admission; packet-only code is not mislabeled RFC9221.

items.description: After step3 resolves each exact ring, read only its producer/consumer/notification/lifetime callers and the matching pinned protocol/spec or upstream implementation. acceptance.text: All four coordinator-named rings have individual source identity, owner/transition/overflow/cancel analysis, alternatives and exact unrun measurement/reproduction requirements; unresolved rings stay unverified.

No production ring depth, allocation strategy, page size or architecture is selected solely from specs or copied upstream defaults; no duplicate watched/in-flight state appears without consistency proof.
